verdict.rationale: Orb is API-first for core actions (e.g., subscription creation, event ingestion, webhooks) which implies operations can be automated without the UI, but there is no evidence of a CLI, SDK, or explicit CI/pipeline integration story — the evidence never discusses running Orb 'headlessly' in an automation/CI context. missing for 10: CLI or SDK for automation, explicit CI/pipeline integration examples, documentation framing API use as headless/agentic automation.
